_comment: Copy this file, fill it in for one project, pass it with --glossary. Every key is optional. All patterns are Python regular expressions applied case insensitively. The values below are synthetic examples, not real corrections.
_comment_fillers_single: CAUTION: only list words that are never meaningful in your speech. 'like' looks tempting and is a trap: stripping it turns 'looks like it works' into 'looks it works'. Same for 'right', 'well', 'so' and 'just'. Put those in fillers_multi as a longer phrase instead, for example 'i mean like'.
